government.title: Online administration
government.subTitle: With the experience of the Covid-19 pandemic, we have all understood that it is imperative that both public and private services are accessible online and to all citizens.

more.title1H1: Digital System for Company Registration and Investment Promotion
more.subText1: « Register your company in a few clicks »
more.description1: With our application, entrepreneurs can set up a company, association or foundation completely digitally (online) by pre-encoding the main elements required.

procedures.title: Our simplified procedure :
description: Access the registration system via mobile phone, computer or tablet (anywhere and anytime)
Fill in your business registration details
Pay online if there is a fee for registration
Get your virtual business registration certificate
Approval of your business registration by a competent authority

more.subText2: The digitalisation of public procurement is the possibility for service providers to conclude public contracts via an online platform.

procedures1.title: Our simplified procedure
description: The government launches a call for tender via a platform
Suppliers submit their bids online
Evaluation of tenders by the competent authority is done online
Contracts are signed

more.subText3: Our platform is designed to provide online services to improve the delivery of services to citizens and regulatory businesses in key sectors, such as :
description3: postal services, ICT, water and sanitation
nuclear & radiation, electricity, gas and oil

benefits.title: The benefits
description: Automate the time-consuming process of license renewal applications
Simplify manual approvals of long-haul workflows
Automate regulatory fee calculations and collections.
